title: Surreal Swamp Portal
description: In a vibrant swamp at sunset, a bearded man sits in a red wagon holding a wooden chair while a woman in a black dress pulls him along a glowing pink path. A glowing purple portal swirls between the tentacles of a giant green octopus-like creature emerging from the water near a moss-covered tree with pink blossoms, a white heron, and black birds perched on a green wooden gazebo.
prompt: A surreal fantasy swamp scene at sunset with orange and purple skies. A giant green octopus creature with glowing orange eyes emerges from the water, its tentacles holding a swirling pink and purple portal. In the foreground, a bearded man in a black jacket sits in a red wagon holding a wooden chair while a smiling blonde woman in a short black dress pulls him along a glowing pink path. A large mossy tree with pink blossoms stands nearby with a white heron perched on a branch and several black crows on a green wooden Victorian-style gazebo with a hammock. Bioluminescent plants and reflections in the water, detailed digital painting style.
